note: V1 SEI pack (k 1e-12->3e-13, SEI i0 1.5e-7->7.5e-8): SEI100 416.2<=500 pass, SEI500 736.1>550 fail. Measured sensitivity far below sqrt(k) expectation (-5.4% vs -45%): diagnosed the ec-reaction-limited growth (Yang2017) is diffusion-limited at L>100 nm (L*k_exp/D_ec >> 1, D_ec=2e-18), i.e. j_sei ~ F*c0*D_ec/L -> L^2 ~ D_ec*t; the k prefactor is almost inactive at these thicknesses. Round-3 SEI lever: EC diffusivity D_ec (film permeability, additive-derived denser SEI).

V2 constant negative exchange-current density 2.0 A/m2, SPMe measurement: 4C charge anode min -0.4186 V vs baseline -0.4385 V -> still plated; marginal improvement only in SPMe. Later DFN diagnostics showed the SPMe c_e profile is unreliable for thick-anode geometries (negative electrolyte concentration artifact at neg 250 um), so SPMe 4C plating values are superseded by DFN runs in round 3.

V3 thick electrodes (pos 100 um, neg 150 um, radii 3.0/3.5 um): ED 509.4 Wh/kg pass, lowT retention 99.99% pass, but 4C SPMe anode min -0.5228 V -> plated fail (deeper dip than baseline: longer charge gives the anode surface more time to enrich). SPMe caveat as V2: DFN re-validation in round 3 (DFN is the reliable mode for thick anodes).
